title: 5x2
events_chronological: On a beach in Sardinia, Marion notices Gilles, who is on holiday there with his girlfriend Valerie.
Valerie flies home after a quarrel, and Gilles knocks at Marion's hotel door that evening.
Marion and Gilles walk out into the sea together at sunset.
At their wedding in a country hotel, Marion's separated parents sit at opposite ends of the table and the speeches are cold.
Gilles falls asleep drunk on the wedding night, and Marion lets a stranger from the corridor into the room.
Their son is delivered by emergency caesarean while Gilles sits in the car park unable to make himself come in.
Gilles reaches the ward hours afterwards and admits where he has been.
At a dinner for Gilles's brother and his boyfriend, Gilles describes watching strangers have sex at a club.
Marion says at the same table that she was there and watched as well, and the evening curdles.
Marion and Gilles start sleeping in separate rooms, and Gilles takes a lover at his office.
A clerk in a solicitor's office reads out the terms of their divorce and the two of them sign.
They take a hotel room afterwards, have sex once more, and Gilles dresses and leaves Marion lying on the bed.
syuzhet_notes: Five self-contained episodes play in reverse order, each opening after the previous one has already been undone: the divorce first, the first meeting last. Nothing in the telling ever moves forward between episodes.
fabula_notes: Each episode is one continuous stretch, so its own bullets play in order; the reversal is entirely at the level of the five episodes.
